project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Move away from dense supervised minute ranking after R3E/R3F/R3G failed. Test a sparse structural opening-session hypothesis designed for larger gross movement: when an unusually large opening dislocation is followed by unusually strong 30-minute directional movement confirmed by SENSEX and inverse VIX, follow the current opening direction with a horizon chosen causally from trend efficiency.

signal.candidate_direction: sign of NIFTY causal 30-minute return at the checkpoint; positive=CE, negative=PE
signal.opening_gap_measure: absolute NIFTY opening gap in bps versus prior session close
signal.momentum_measure: absolute NIFTY causal 30-minute return in bps
signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date checkpoint observations of the same clock checkpoint only
signal.gap_condition: abs opening gap >= prior-history quantile Q
signal.momentum_condition: abs NIFTY 30-minute return >= prior-history quantile Q
signal.sensex_confirmation: SENSEX causal 15-minute return has the same sign as candidate direction
signal.vix_confirmation: India VIX causal 15-minute return has the opposite sign to candidate direction
signal.session_location_confirmation: CE requires NIFTY session_pos >= 0.65; PE requires session_pos <= 0.35

horizon_router.trend_threshold: median trend_eff_30 over previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same checkpoint
horizon_router.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after checkpoint

execution.if_multiple_same_timestamp: not possible after deterministic direction/horizon router

calibration.selection_rule: Among Q values passing every gate, choose highest worst-half net3 mean, then highest overall net3 mean, then highest net5 mean, then stricter Q.
calibration.if_none_pass: Retire R3H and do not open 2024 for R3H. Preregister a distinct R3I before any R3I output.

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
